description:
Checks a Hyperliquid perp order BEFORE your agent sends it: would the exchange reject it, and what does it cost and risk? Give coin, side and size (coins) or notional (USD); optional limit price, leverage, margin cross/isolated, reduceOnly. Returns REJECT_LIKELY / CAUTION / OK, issues[] with fix values (size decimals, tick, $10 minimum, leverage tier, OI cap, delisted), liquidation estimate, taker impact, funding carry. Free: 30 calls/day per IP.
Not for: placing, signing or cancelling orders (read-only, no keys, no custody) or other exchanges. Not financial advice.

[PerpCheck via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as PerpCheck's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.003 / full $0.01 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

coin.description: Hyperliquid main-dex perp name, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, kPEPE

notional.description: Order value in USD (instead of size), e.g. 100

price.description: Limit price exactly as you would send it (tick rule is checked). Omit for a market order (then taker impact is estimated from the L2 book).

reduceOnly.description: true if the order only reduces a position (exempt from the minimum and OI cap)

size.description: Order size in coins, exactly as you would send it (decimals are checked), e.g. 0.001. Give size or notional.

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.003, full $0.01. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

name: check_perp_order
title: PerpCheck: Hyperliquid pre-trade order check
